sub: Google streamlined how you appeal a suspended or restricted Business Profile.

slides.title: What changed
slides.body:
The appeal is now one page with fewer clicks.
You can upload several documents at once and explain your situation before you submit.
slides.tip: Documents are optional, but they help.

slides.title: Who it affects
slides.body:
Any business whose Google profile was suspended, disabled or had content restricted.
If your profile shows a suspended, disabled or restricted notice, this is the process you'll use.

slides.title: What to do this week
slides.body:
Gather proof before you appeal: business registration, license, tax certificate or a utility bill.
Make sure the name and address match your profile exactly.
slides.tip: You only get one appeal. Get it right the first time.

cta.head: Questions about this change?
cta.sub: We help local businesses get suspended profiles back.
